chunks: And from him, from his father, from Saad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Rizq Allah ibn al-Ala', from Sulayman ibn Umar al-Sarraj, from some of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The clay of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) is taken from near the grave within a radius of seventy cubits.

key_terms.طِينُ قَبْرِ الْحُسَيْنِ: Clay of the grave of al-Husayn

ai.seo_question: What is the defined radius for collecting the clay of Imam Husayn's grave?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* delineates the specific radius of seventy cubits from Imam al-Husayn’s grave for collecting ritual clay (turba), a measurement that has been central to Shia jurisprudential discussions regarding the sanctity of Karbala’s soil. The specification underscores the theological importance of the physical earth of the martyr as a medium for blessing (barakah) and spiritual connection, distinguishing the immediate sacred precinct from the broader region.
